archetypes.title: Urban Pocket Park
archetypes.description: A small urban green space tucked between buildings, offering shade trees, a bench loop, and a patch of open lawn visible as a compact emerald oasis from above

styleProfile.landscapeCharacter: A compact urban pocket park seen from drone altitude. Two to four mature deciduous shade trees with broad rounded canopies cast dappled shadows across a small central lawn panel. A single curving decomposed-granite path loops through the space connecting two entry points. One wooden bench sits beneath each tree. A low ornamental hedge borders the perimeter. The grass is lush dark green and freshly mowed. From above the canopy reads as overlapping dark-green circles against bright lawn.

styleProfile.plantingType: Mature shade trees with rounded canopy, low perennial border

archetypes.title: Neighborhood Park
archetypes.description: A mid-sized community park with open playing fields, a playground cluster, scattered mature trees, and a perimeter walking loop

styleProfile.landscapeCharacter: A mid-sized neighborhood park viewed from 60m drone altitude. A large open grass field occupies the center, bright green and striped from mowing. Clusters of six to ten mature deciduous trees with broad canopies line the east and west edges, their shadows stretching across the grass. A paved asphalt walking loop traces the full perimeter. A compact playground area in one corner shows colorful equipment dots — slides, swings, climbing structures — on a tan rubber-mulch surface. A small parking pull-off with four to six car-sized rectangles sits at one entrance. Benches dot the path at regular intervals.

Multiple distinct zones are visible: a wide open sports lawn with faint white line markings, a dense picnic grove of mature trees casting deep shadows, a curving network of paved trails, and a naturalized pond with rushes along the margin. Rows of deciduous trees line internal pathways. The grass transitions from manicured bright green near the main entrance to wilder meadow tones at the edges. A small pavilion structure with a pale roof sits near the picnic area. From above, the park reads as a mosaic of green textures — dark canopy clusters, medium lawn, light meadow.

archetypes.title: Botanical Garden
archetypes.description: A curated botanical garden with themed planting beds, specimen trees, winding paths through diverse horticultural displays, and a glass conservatory

styleProfile.landscapeCharacter: A botanical garden seen from drone altitude. A rich tapestry of diverse planting beds arranged in geometric and organic shapes — each bed a distinct color and texture: deep green conifers, silvery Mediterranean herbs, bright flower borders in pinks and purples, golden ornamental grasses. Winding pale gravel paths meander between beds. A glass conservatory or greenhouse structure with a translucent roof sits in one section, its metal frame casting a geometric shadow. Specimen trees of varying species create a varied canopy — some conical, some spreading, some columnar. Informational signs are too small to read from above but appear as tiny light dots at path intersections. A formal rose garden section shows concentric circular beds radiating from a central sundial or fountain.

archetypes.title: Japanese Garden
archetypes.description: A contemplative Japanese garden with raked gravel, moss gardens, ornamental maples, a koi pond, and stepping-stone paths — an intricate miniature landscape from above

styleProfile.landscapeCharacter: A Japanese garden seen from drone altitude. A central koi pond with dark still water is edged by carefully placed boulders and moss-covered banks. A red-painted arched bridge spans a narrow section of the pond. Raked gravel areas show concentric wave patterns in pale beige. Japanese maple trees display deep red and orange canopy alongside dark green conifers — shaped pines with cloud-pruned rounded forms. Stepping-stone paths appear as chains of small gray circles through moss groundcover. A stone lantern stands at a path intersection. The composition is asymmetrical and deliberately naturalistic yet highly controlled. Bamboo groves form dense vertical screens at boundaries.

archetypes.title: Memorial Garden
archetypes.description: A solemn memorial garden with formal axial layout, reflection pools, commemorative walls, and evergreen plantings — a symmetrical composition from above

styleProfile.landscapeCharacter: A memorial garden viewed from drone altitude. A strong central axis runs the length of the space, defined by a long narrow reflecting pool with dark still water flanked by pale stone paving. Rows of identical evergreen trees — dark conical forms — line both sides of the axis in formal symmetry. A commemorative wall or monument reads as a solid dark rectangle at the terminus of the axis. Low clipped hedges border the walkways in geometric precision. The paving is polished stone or granite in muted grays and warm tones. Small memorial plaques or markers are arranged in a grid pattern on either side. The overall composition is bilaterally symmetrical and restrained.

styleProfile.landscapeCharacter: An urban forest patch viewed from drone altitude. The canopy is nearly continuous — overlapping crowns of mature deciduous and evergreen trees forming a dense dark-green mat with only small gaps where sunlight penetrates to the forest floor. A narrow footpath is barely visible as a thin brown line threading through canopy gaps. The tree canopy shows variation in tone — some lighter deciduous greens, darker evergreen patches, and occasional understory trees in a lighter shade. The edges transition from dense canopy to a scrubby understory buffer before meeting adjacent development. No lawn, no formal paths, no structures — pure woodland.

styleProfile.landscapeCharacter: A riparian buffer corridor viewed from drone altitude. The vegetation is dense and naturalistic — weeping willow canopies draping toward the water, native shrub thickets in medium green, and tall grasses in golden-green tones along the banks. The corridor is linear, following the creek's meander. A narrow crushed-gravel trail runs parallel to the creek, set back from the banks. The edges transition from dense riparian vegetation to maintained lawn or meadow. Erosion-control boulders are visible along steeper banks as gray dots.
